label: KSafe
description: Karoo safety extension on two layers: REACTIVE (crash detection, SOS, check-in, HR-based medical episode and wellness detection) and PREVENTIVE (carb and hydration tracking that adapts to your effort using the Karoo's HR and power zones, reminding you to fuel before bonking or dehydration impair your judgment on the bike). Sends emergency alerts via WhatsApp (CallMeBot), Telegram, Pushover or ntfy. Beta — test before relying on it.
releaseNotes: Crash-detection v2.1.0 — orientation-aware silence check. The algorithm now learns the bike's upright gravity vector during steady cruising (≥15 km/h, smooth tarmac) and uses it inside the silence check to distinguish a real crash (bike on its side) from a rider who hit a bump and stopped upright to recover. Real crashes that lay the bike on its side still confirm at the same 4.5 s threshold as before — zero new false negatives. The bump-then-brake-to-stop class of false positives, where riders stand still verifying themselves after a scare, is now suppressed: the algorithm requires 20 s of absolute stillness before confirming when the bike is upright vs the baseline. Any micro-movement (foot down, head turn, glancing at the Karoo) resets the silence clock — so practical riders almost never trip the upright timer at a stoplight. New calibration log fields (ORIENT_BASE event + per-impact ax/ay/az + base_ready + base_x/y/z) let the analyser replay historical IMPACT_IN events through the new gate offline.
